ayahs.2: Aur apne Rabb ke hukm par kaan lagaayega aur isi ke laayaq woh hai.
ayahs.3: Aur jab zameen (kheench kar) phailaa di jaayegi.
ayahs.4: Aur is mein jo hai use woh ugal degi aur khaali ho jaayegi.
ayahs.5: Aur apne Rabb ke hukm par kaan lagaayegi aur isi ke laayaq woh hai.
ayahs.6: Ae insaan! Tu apne Rabb se milne tak yeh koshish aur tamaam kaam aur mehnaten karke us se mulaaqaat karne wala hai.
ayahs.7: To (us waqt) jis shakhs ke daahne haath mein aamaal-naama diya jaayega.
ayahs.8: Us ka hisaab to badi aasaani se liya jaayega.
ayahs.9: Aur woh apne ahl ki taraf hansi-khushi laut aayega.
ayahs.10: Haan jis shakhs ka aamaal-naama us ki peeth ke peechhe se diya jaayega.
ayahs.11: To woh maut ko bulaane lagega.
ayahs.12: Aur bhadakti hui jahannam mein daakhil hoga.
ayahs.13: Yeh shakhs apne mutaalliqeen mein (dunya mein) khush tha.
ayahs.14: Us ka khayaal tha ke Allah ki taraf laut kar hi na jaayega.
ayahs.15: Kyun nahin, halaanke us ka Rabb use ba-khoobi dekh raha tha.
ayahs.16: Mujhe shafaq ki qasam! Aur raat ki!
ayahs.17: Aur is ki jama karda cheezon ki qasam.
ayahs.18: Aur chaand ki jab ke woh kaamil ho jaata hai.
ayahs.19: Yaqeenan tum ek haalat se doosri haalat par pahunchoge.
ayahs.20: Unhein kya ho gaya ke imaan nahin laate.
ayahs.21: Aur jab un ke paas Quran padha jaata hai to sajda nahin karte.
ayahs.22: Balke jinhon ne kufr kiya woh jhutla rahe hain.
ayahs.23: Aur Allah Taala khoob jaanta hai jo kuchh yeh dilon mein rakhte hain.
ayahs.24: Unhein alamnaak azaabon ki khushkhabri suna do.
ayahs.25: Haan imaan walon aur nek aamaal walon ko be-shumaar aur na khatm hone wala ajr hai.
